mapper.sql: request_id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, expected_version, desired_version, desired_state::text AS desired_state_json, request_sha256, command_id, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, applied_at, status_updated_at, projection_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM device_desired_shadow_request WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id, device_id, desired_version, request_id, desired_state::text AS desired_state_json, updated_at FROM device_desired_shadow_current WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT request.request_id, request.tenant_id, request.organization_id, request.device_id, request.requested_by, request.idempotency_key, request.expected_version, request.desired_version, request.desired_state::text AS desired_state_json, request.request_sha256, request.command_id, request.status, request.failure_code, request.requested_at, request.expires_at, request.applied_at, request.status_updated_at, request.projection_version FROM device_desired_shadow_current current_state JOIN device_desired_shadow_request request ON request.request_id = current_state.request_id AND request.tenant_id = current_state.tenant_id WHERE current_state.device_id = #{deviceId}
SELECT FROM device_desired_shadow_request WHERE command_id = #{commandId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT request.request_id, request.tenant_id, request.organization_id, request.device_id, request.requested_by, request.idempotency_key, request.expected_version, request.desired_version, request.desired_state::text AS desired_state_json, request.request_sha256, request.command_id, request.status, request.failure_code, request.requested_at, request.expires_at, request.applied_at, request.status_updated_at, request.projection_version FROM device_desired_shadow_current current_state JOIN device_desired_shadow_request request ON request.request_id = current_state.request_id AND request.tenant_id = current_state.tenant_id WHERE current_state.device_id = #{deviceId} FOR UPDATE OF request
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_desired_shadow_request(request_id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, expected_version, desired_version, desired_state, request_sha256, command_id, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, applied_at, status_updated_at, projection_version) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{deviceId}, #{requestedBy}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{expectedVersion}, #{desiredVersion}, CAST(#{desiredStateJson} AS jsonb), #{requestSha256}, #{commandId}, #{status}, #{failureCode}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{appliedAt}, #{statusUpdatedAt}, #{projectionVersion}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, requested_by, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO device_desired_shadow_current(tenant_id, device_id, desired_version, request_id, desired_state, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{desiredVersion}, #{requestId}, CAST(#{desiredStateJson} AS jsonb), #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE device_desired_shadow_request SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', status_updated_at = #{at}, projection_version = projection_version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status NOT IN ('APPLIED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED', 'SUPERSEDED')
